component.name: FastFoto Linux
component.summary: Scan photos with the Epson FastFoto FF-680W

description.p: Scan stacks of photos with the Epson FastFoto FF-680W over USB or Wi-Fi. Each photo is cropped, turned upright and saved with its album and date; the back of a photo is kept beside its front when it has handwriting, and an enhanced copy restores faded colours.
This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Seiko Epson.
